scope: Exhaustive full-row positive-tail order-separation bank census, not a gate-bound proof or circuit search. Distinct original-input OR pairs only. Every valid bank contains a listed inclusion-minimal bank; presence of both complements is pattern3. Equal OR pairs collapse semantically to the one-NOT family and are not enumerated.
root_positions: 0..9 inputs;10,11 positive OR sources;12,13 their complements
